lines.en: Joey, you will totally keep it in check this time.
And plus, you know, the publicity would be really good
for your career, and you deserve that.
And if you do the interview, you could mention,
oh, I don't know, gal pal Rachel Green?
Is that gal pal spelled L-O-S-E-R?
Okay, don't listen to him. Please.
Fine, all right, I'll do it.
But, hey, you guys have to be at the next table
so you can stop me if I, you know,
start to say something stupid.
Just then or, or all the time?
'Cause we have jobs, you know?
Come on, we will be there for you the whole time.
Just remember, gal pal Rachel Green.
I'm gonna be in Self-Offer Digest!
And not just in the dumb crossword puzzle.
Seriously, proud of you.
Yeah.
you
